overview.processingCredit: Processing level is NouriSearch's own rule-based classification.
recipe.label: Recipe
recipe.surveyNote: This is a USDA survey recipe, a composite used to estimate what people eat. It is not an authentic recipe for this dish.
related.none: Nothing related has been found yet.
ingredients.title: Ingredients
ingredients.none: USDA lists no ingredient breakdown for this food, so nothing can be traced to an ingredient.
ingredients.noQuantity: A source of {nutrient}, amount not stated
ingredients.contributesNothing: Supplies 5% or more of no nutrient with known data.
modified.title: Modified version
modified.count: {count} excluded. Values are recalculated from USDA's recipe.
modified.failed: That change could not be calculated, so the dish is back to how it was.
profile.title: Your nutrient profile
profile.unavailable: Saving foods to your profile is not available yet.
profile.pageBody: Your nutrient profile is not available yet. It will use foods you choose or mark as eaten, not your searches.
nutrients.title: Nutrients
nutrients.noServing: USDA lists no household serving, so values are per 100 g.
nutrients.scale: Bars show percent of the Daily Value in this serving. The tick marks {threshold}%, which the FDA treats as high.
mark.question: Unknown
detail.noContributors: This food has no ingredient breakdown to trace this to.
detail.estimated: Borrowed from a similar food, so this is an estimate.
detail.approximate: This recipe does not fully explain USDA's published value, so the change is approximate.
detail.lowerBound: The true value is at least this much, because some ingredients have no data.
detail.unknownValue: No source gives a value for this nutrient in this food.
detail.zeroReported: USDA reports zero here without saying whether it was measured or assumed.
detail.zeroAssumed: USDA assumes zero here, because the nutrient is insignificant or does not occur naturally in this food.
detail.totalSugarsNote: The FDA sets a Daily Value for added sugars, not for total sugars, so these grams have no Daily Value to compare with.
detail.addedSugarsNote: USDA's data has no added-sugar values, so this stays unknown unless a food label states one. The Daily Value is {dailyValue} g.
detail.noDailyValue: The FDA sets no Daily Value for this nutrient.
conclusion.high_percent_daily_value: This serving ({serving}) has {percent} of the Daily Value. The FDA treats {threshold}% or more as high.
conclusion.high_percent_daily_value.lowe: This serving ({serving}) has at least {percent} of the Daily Value, which is already above the {threshold}% the FDA treats as high.
conclusion.not_high_percent_daily_value: This serving ({serving}) has {percent} of the Daily Value, below the {threshold}% the FDA treats as high.
conclusion.could_not_evaluate.no_value: We cannot tell whether this serving ({serving}) is high, because the amount is unknown.
conclusion.could_not_evaluate.no_daily_v: We cannot tell whether this serving ({serving}) is high, because no Daily Value applies.
conclusion.could_not_evaluate.lower_boun: This serving ({serving}) has at least {percent} of the Daily Value. Some ingredients have no data, so it could still reach the {threshold}% the FDA treats as high.
